instruction: Review the book reading spreadsheet on the desktop. Among all books that received a 5-star rating, find the one that was read at the slowest pace (lowest words per day). Write its title in 'book_list_result.docx' on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the 5-star book with slowest reading pace. Verified from Excel: 4 books have 5.0 rating - Fire and Blood (4797.59), Song of Solomon (2105.46), The Andromeda Strain (3259.1), Silence (1984.27). Silence has the slowest pace at 1984.27 words/day.
